keyInsights.title: NEPSE Continues Decline — 185 Declines vs 74 Advances
keyInsights.body: NEPSE fell another -0.41% to 2755.41 on June 5, marking the 2nd consecutive red session. Market breadth: 185 declines vs 74 advances (2.5:1 ratio). Finance (+2.77%) and Hotels (+0.05%) were the only notable sector bright spots. HydroPower (-0.74%) and Manufacturing (-0.79%) led sector losses. Turnover of Rs.5.63B was higher than previous session's Rs.4.70B, suggesting active selling at lower levels.

keyInsights.title: B58 Strong NET BUYER — +Rs.131.78M Conviction
keyInsights.body: Despite the red market, B58 was a strong net buyer with +Rs.131.78M net inflow (purchases Rs.468.5M vs sales Rs.336.7M). This is significantly larger than the previous session's marginal +Rs.5.15M. Key buys: AKJCL (254,523 net kitta), CITY (105,821 net kitta), NHPC (52,032 pure buy), SMJC (20,350 at 40.08% — highest concentration), KSBBL (15,533 at 32.12%). B58 is aggressively buying into market weakness.
